data.title: Ethereum Price Forecast: ETH Can Still Rally to $2.5K as Whales Keep Buying
data.description: Ethereum (ETH) continues to hold above key support levels, bolstered by persistent whale accumulation led by Tom Lee’s BitMine and strong month-to-date ETF inflows. If the price breaks above $1,950, ETH could set eyes on $2,500 in the near term.
